label: Normalized law on a two-point outcome space
definition: A Mathlib PMF on Bool with supplied mass p at true and q at false, where p+q=1 (the full-support controls also require p,q>0). Each use fixes what the two points are: the will-versus-chance controls read them as the existing withholding (true) and giving (false) histories of the fixed giver theistG; the objective-probability diagnostics read them as two physical outcomes.
note: Purely mathematical: the numbers are supplied, not inferred from accessibility, an invariant intrinsic set-up or a causal power, and a PMF is neither a propensity nor a measure over metaphysical worlds. Objective causal applicability is a separate commitment of each use.
